FEEDBACK: Remove the hasComponent/structuralMember indirection and validate the supplied formula operands on the authoritative ship owner itself. The current queries place flangeOutstand, netFlangeThickness, and especially yieldStrength on a structural member even though their requiredOwner and requiredTargetOwner are ship, and they can pass accidentally when a ship has no matching member. Keep sh:targetClass nltl:ship, require decimal QUDT values in MilliM, MilliM, and MegaPA directly for each ship, enforce positive net thickness and yield strength, and apply b_out/t_fn <= 155/sqrt(sigma_y) with the same comparison direction using one bounded formula query plus SHACL Core presence/datatype/unit constraints.

Candidate faithfully targets ships, constrains all required quantities with correct datatypes and units, and encodes the formula comparison in an algebraically equivalent bounded SPARQL check with the correct threshold and direction.
